conclusion: the zero-start virtual protected window upper-bounds every admissible inherited-HI response window
exact_statement: Consider a HI job released at relative time r>=0 inside an already active HI-mode interval. If the protected HI demand order is monotone under carry-in translation and the inherited job has the same execution, deadline and higher-priority demand parameters as the corresponding virtual-switch job, then the response-demand window beginning at virtual switch time 0 dominates the inherited window and supplies an upper bound for the inherited job.
